subject: Insurance
title: Root Insurance and Phone Sensors
description: A fast breakdown of Root Insurance and Phone Sensors for builders.

hook.text: Root Insurance uses your phone's sensors to score your driving—no plug-in device needed.

buildup.text: During a test period, the app monitors acceleration, braking, turning, and phone usage while driving.

discovery.text: Your score determines your premium. Root claims good drivers save up to 52% compared to traditional insurance.

twist.text: Phone-based scoring is less accurate than dedicated telematics hardware.

climax.text: Smartphone telematics democratizes usage-based insurance. Everyone has a phone; not everyone will install a device.

punchline.text: Your phone scores your driving. No device, up to 52% savings.

quiz.question: How does Root Insurance monitor driving behavior?
